model: alpha1,16 independent unnormalised body Cauchy directions in R5, Lebesgue measure, Fourier inverse(2*pi)^-5
numerical_quantities: Only center H_epsilon and its four physical tail-coordinate first derivatives, using all3504 simplices and exact rational log stencils. No fullG or third-order replay, no H at another point.
finite_algebra: Check determinant and inverse of this one fixed basis, restricted Q=N^-T N^-1,16 sign corners, and one centered Q-ellipsoid. No optimization over N or epsilon.
safe_cube: Take the minimum of16 explicit positive roots of the conservative lower-log-paraboloid corner quadratics, then round downward to denominator2^24; also clip to the positive unit face. This is maximum for that conservative paraboloid test, not maximum for H.
safe_ellipsoid: Use rho from Delta-B*rho-rho^2/epsilon^2>=0, with exact directed Delta lower and B>=sqrt(gradlogH' Q^-1 gradlogH). Round rho downward to denominator2^24 and verify rational residual.
stop_condition: Exactly one H object, five center quantities, one fixed box and the explicit paraboloid regions. No global spatial mesh, second epsilon, basis search or extra kernel points. Preserve a source-locked external checkpoint if120s is reached.
scope: Independently prove all positive-mixture differentiation/finite-score conditions. Numeric data gives global bounds on the affine x1=1 plane only; the full5D theorem is analytic and no fifth gradient is sampled. No global g or C5 improvement. No MATLAB/commit or edits to frozen sources.
